en:
Nothing in the entrance hall...
Something outside, perhaps?

Maybe that sound was something 
falling off the roof?

F-For now let's go outside 
and check—

That was Keebo's voice, right!?
I think I heard him outside! He sounded close!
But Keebo should be in the chapel, why...?

Anyway, let's go outside! It'll be faster 
to see it for ourselves!
I don't know why I heard Keebo's voice, but...

<CLT=cltMIND>I could hear Keebo's voice outside!
I have to check!
